claims.text: The architecture of the span detector includes a Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) and a binary classifier for determining if a question is unanswerable.
The span detector and binary classifier share a lower layer to reduce parameters, while having separate top layers for their respective tasks.
The model employs a multi-turn answer module for the span detector.
